Check a plan against its rules

Source: R/constraints.R
check_constraints.Rd

Measures each rule of a PlanConstraints on a plan and reports how it stands: the actual measure, the rule's limit, the slack between them, and whether the rule is ok. Rules are measured day by day, through calendarize(), so a rule's window may cut a week or a month anywhere.

Usage

check_constraints(plan, constraints, reference = NULL)

Arguments

plan

A MediaPlan.

constraints

A PlanConstraints.

reference

The plan change rules are measured against – normally the plan's parent, or the current approved plan (current_approved()). Required when constraints has a max_change_* rule.

Value

A data frame, one row per rule:

rule

Its position in constraints; NA for row_bounds.

type, target, window, note

The rule, in words.

limit

The rule's value.

actual

What the plan measures: the target's spend, its share of the plan, or how far it moved from the reference.

slack

How far inside its limit the rule is; negative is how far outside. Always 0 or less for fixed_total.

ok

Whether the rule holds.

Details

Like check_budget(), this warns rather than errors on a violation: the plan and its rules are each valid, and an agent or a planner checking a proposal needs to see what it breaks, not be refused. It does error on a rule it cannot measure – a target naming a value the plan does not have, or a change rule with no reference to change from.

Rules about groups of rows live here; rules about single rows are the plan's own spend bounds, which the plan's validator already guarantees. They are reported anyway, as one row_bounds row, so the report is complete.

See also

plan_constraints(); describe_plan(), which summarises the check when given constraints.

Examples

plan <- media_plan_from_df(
  data.frame(month = as.Date("2026-10-01"),
             channel = c("Streaming", "Programmatic", "Online Video"),
             planned_spend = c(500, 300, 200)),
  grain = "channel", time = "month", name = "Q4"
)
rules <- plan_constraints(list(
  rule_min_share(0.4, target = list(channel = "Streaming")),
  rule_max_change_pct(0.25, target = list(channel = "Online Video"))
), name = "guardrails")

check_constraints(plan, rules, reference = plan)
#>   rule           type               target window limit actual slack   ok note
#> 1    1      min_share    channel Streaming   <NA>  0.40    0.5  0.10 TRUE     
#> 2    2 max_change_pct channel Online Video   <NA>  0.25    0.0  0.25 TRUE     

moved <- build_scenario(plan, name = "more video", edits = op_transfer(
  150, from = list(channel = "Streaming"), to = list(channel = "Online Video")))
check_constraints(moved, rules, reference = plan)
#> Warning: 2 of 2 rule(s) violated: min_share 0.4 on channel Streaming: actual 0.35 (slack -0.05); max_change_pct 0.25 on channel Online Video: actual 0.75 (slack -0.5).
#>   rule           type               target window limit actual slack    ok note
#> 1    1      min_share    channel Streaming   <NA>  0.40   0.35 -0.05 FALSE     
#> 2    2 max_change_pct channel Online Video   <NA>  0.25   0.75 -0.50 FALSE
